digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify gate and corpus testing
propositions: Complete live-Pandoc corpus replay in Gerrit Verify contributes a measured 184-second macOS lower bound and should be moved out of the per-change hot path while retaining complete replay capability elsewhere

Committed deterministic Pandoc outputs for all corpus inputs should back static converter-driven assertions in Gerrit Verify, replacing subprocess invocation for broad corpus cardinality, scrubbing, protection, table, settling, and richness assertions

Three representative live product-path bodies (one each from code_arrow, table, and prose strata) plus compact version, platform, and dispatch probes should remain in Gerrit Verify to retain contractual real-Pandoc validation
An external weekly and manual pandoc-corpus-replay job should exercise the complete corpus and all settling passes through real Pandoc on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest matrix arms
Fixture generation, validation, and provenance checking (Pandoc version, platform fingerprint, binary SHA-256) must be deterministic, fail-closed on mismatch, and support non-writing validation
